title: Understanding Bimodal Distributions
text: A bimodal distribution has two distinct peaks. Look at the spread of data points for each shape. Do you see two separate clusters of weights for any shape?

title: Interpreting Box Plots
text: Box plots show the median, quartiles, and potential outliers. They help visualize the spread and central tendency of data. Consider how this information might reveal a bimodal distribution.

title: Analyzing the Plot
text: Does the plot show two distinct clusters of nugget weights for any shape?
